 Motorized Tensile Testers & Universal Testing Machines
 LS Series
Lloyd Instruments

REQUEST CALIBRATON 
Description
The LSPlus materials testing machines from Lloyd Instruments are easy-to-use universal testing machines ideal for materials testing up to 5 kN (1124 lbf). The machines use high-accuracy interchangeable YLC Series load cells for tension, compression and cycling through zero-force measurements, and they have an accuracy of ±0.5% from 1% to 100% of load cell value.
The LS Series have a large working area and come in three sizes and capacities: the LS1Plus (up to 1 kN/225 lbf), the LS2.5Plus (up to 2.5 kN/562 lbf) and the LS5Plus (5kN/1124 lbf). The LS2.5 is an extended travel version of the series with over 55 inches of travel.
These materials testing machines feature an integral control console with a multi-function keyboard and easy-to-read backlit LCD to display load and extension information. The control console displays prompts and menus, which guide the user through machine operations.
With the interchangeable grips and the wide range of test types in the NEXYGENPlus software, the LS materials testing machines are ideal for product development, production testing, and quality control.
The NEXYGENPlus software interacts with Excel and Word, offering you the possibility of automatically transferring your test results directly into your own corporate templates.
Contact us to learn more about Lloyd Instruments test stands
Features
High Mechanical Stiffness: Modern linear guide technology, pre-loaded ball screws and advanced software compensation ensures high displacement precision.
Wide Speed Range: High precision and improved productivity 0.01-2032 mm/min (0.0004-80 in/min) - depending on model.
Exceptional Load Accuracy: Load accuracy of +/- 0.5% down to 1% of load cell value provides a high dynamic range, thereby reducing the number of load cells required to cover the full force range
Advanced Test Setup with NEXYGENPlus 4 Software
Test Types: Tensile testing, compression testing, flexural testing, friction, insertion/extraction, peeling, tearing, creep/relaxation. User Configurable for multistage tests and specialized testing.
Control Interface: PC interface is via USB allowing standard laptops to be used with no special PC interface cards required
Export data directly into your Excel and Word templates
An extensive built-in library of test methods covering ASTM, DIN, EN, ISO and other standards
Multilingual and multi-unit display options as standard
Optional Extensometers
Long range contacting (250 to 800 mm travel)
Non-contacting video, and high resolution (10 to 80 mm travel)
Epsilon extensometer for short range measurement
Optional pogo design available for large sample testing of up to 78.7 x 78.7 inches.
Optional Safety Shield

FAQs
 Can JLW help me configure a testing system for my application?
 Yes, JLW can give you personalized recommendations based on your application. Our product specialists can help you compare options, understand capabilities, select appropriate fixtures and attachments, and ensure you purchase the right equipment for your needs. 
 Does JLW offer calibration services?
 Yes, JLW has a calibration lab that offers on-site and in-house services. We make significant, continual investments in calibration equipment and technician training to maintain rapid turnaround times, while providing the highest quality calibration services. 
 Where does JLW ship?
 JLW ships nationally and internationally. Customers ordering from outside the United States are responsible for covering all fees imposed during or after shipping (tariffs, taxes, etc.).
